# onetouchswitch-bridge

> Live Blockchain Lab blocks for onetouchswitch.com (UK broadband comparison, built on touch.grok.me): Chainlink GBP/USD, stablecoin payout rails, USDC payout cost in GBP, OFAC payout-address screening, healthy RPC, payout receipt checks, OTS sitemap search. Read-only, keyless, CORS JSON on GitHub Pages; JS client; MCP server.

## API (CORS *, refreshed every 3h)
- [Catalogue](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch-bridge/v1/index.json)
- [Snapshot](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch-bridge/v1/ots.json): gbp_usd, payout_rails, rpc, payout_cost
- [GBP/USD](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch-bridge/v1/gbp-usd.json)
- [Payout cost](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch-bridge/v1/payout-cost.json)
- [Payout rails](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch-bridge/v1/payout-rails.json)
- [OFAC EVM addresses](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch-bridge/v1/sanctioned-evm.json)
- [OTS pages](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch-bridge/v1/ots-pages.json)

## MCP
- npx -y github:Blockchains/onetouchswitch-bridge — tools: ots_gbp_usd, ots_payout_rails, ots_payout_cost, ots_healthy_rpc, ots_screen_payout_address, ots_verify_payout_tx, ots_site_search, ots_snapshot
